limits: New tables are rectangular, one page, up to 20 rows and 10 columns; content must stay in complete tagged passages.
Existing cell roles/scopes can be repaired while retaining spans; padding merged tables is refused.
Keeping tags supports distinct original pages; insertion requires explicit replacement and a new workshop draft.
Keeping tags preserves existing defects. Reordering SSA pages introduces a first-heading sequence issue; the existing PDF/UA identifier is intentionally cleared after edits.
Composite/Type3 fonts cannot be substituted by the simple-font repair; their original font or a regenerated PDF may be needed.
OCR block splitting/merging and actual NVDA/JAWS validation remain outside this addition.
